name: syncourse
description: Syncourse — course delivery & learning platform (mobile + mobile-first web, shared NestJS backend)

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/design-tokens && npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
